_apa_ini: External positive control for bge-gemma, ctxl-6B, and FollowIR-7B, with the same protocol as followir.py (FollowIR, NAACL 2025).

cap_gpu.keputusan: auto: free 15390 - reserve 400 - weights 13813 >= gap 300, loaded fully on the GPU

implementasi_metrik: imported unchanged from followir.py (adapted from MTEB, see NOTICE.md)

kontrak_inferensi.sumber: README of jhu-clsp/FollowIR-7B, template and scoring copied verbatim
kontrak_inferensi.format:
<s> [INST] You are an expert Google searcher, whose job is to determine if the following document is relevant to the query (true/false). Answer using only one word, one of those two choices.

Query: {query}
Document: {text}
Relevant (only output one word, either "true" or "false"): [/INST]
kontrak_inferensi.skor: softmax(logit false, logit true)[true] at the last position
kontrak_inferensi.slot_instruksi: appended to the query text ('Query: {query} {instruksi}'), the FollowIR convention
kontrak_inferensi.bos: double (the template has <s> and the tokenizer adds bos), as in the README
